text:
maria: quick perf sync — noticed p95 regression on route `chat-standard` after kernel 2.1.3 rollout. small-request tail increased ~40ms, throughput same. suspect batch formation + token-budget interaction.

perf-bot: [alert] p95 latency spike on chat-standard at 2026-03-17T22:10Z

maria: logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T22:09:11Z INFO batcher: formed_microbatches=120 single_req_batches=86 avg_batch_size=1.4
2026-03-17T22:09:12Z WARN runtime: token_budget_cutoff route=chat-standard cap=64 generated_batches=120
2026-03-17T22:09:12Z DEBUG kvcache: hit_rate=0.65 prev_baseline=0.87
```

sahil: can you paste the batch size histogram?

maria: pasted hist:
```
size 1: 68%
size 2: 18%
size 3+: 14%
```

elaine: KV hitrate drop is suspicious — did kernel 2.1.3 change KV eviction or prefetch loop?

maria: kernel diff shows altered prefetch window and earlier kv eviction from ~3s->1.2s.

kevin: hypothesis: earlier eviction reduces prefix hits, so requests look longer (more decode) and hit token cap earlier => prevents microbatching forming. two mitigations: 1) taper per-route token cap for standard tier (64->48) 2) increase queue wait to 6ms to allow more coalescing. which to try first?

zane: I'd try queue wait first; lower cap might hurt quality for some long-turn requests.

maria: plan proposal:
- canary 5% traffic on chat-standard to kernel 2.1.3 with queue_wait_ms=6
- measure p95, avg batch size, kv_hit
- run 12h, if p95 improves revert to 100% and open follow-ups

ops-bot: created INF-4823: canary - kernel 2.1.3 queue_wait experiment

perf-bot: uploaded profile: https://internal/perf/3201234567/profile

sahil: I'll own the rollout script, will add smoke checks for batch_size>=1.8 and kv_hit>=0.75

elaine: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert on kv_hit delta > 0.05 vs baseline

maria: note: also capture kernel selected ops (int8 vx kernels) and per-batch kernel switch counts

kevin: also include route-tier dynamic-budgeter flag: enable=false for baseline, we can flip true later

maria: ok starting canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, team ping here when started. :rocket:

zane: ack, will watch logs

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — filing follow-up items in INF-4823 and perf playbook.
